--- layout: default type_slug: bubble title: Bubble Chart in C# — Three-Variable Scatter as SVG nav_title: Bubble Chart description: Plot three variables at once in C# with AddBubble and BubblePoint — X, Y, and size. Self-contained SVG output, zero third-party dependencies. permalink: /chart/types/bubble/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} using TerraFluent.Chart.Reporting.Models; string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Market Share vs. Growth — Bubble Size = Revenue") .Size(700, 400) .XAxis(x => { x.Title = "Market Share (%)"; x.Min = 0; x.Max = 40; }) .YAxis(y => { y.Title = "YoY Growth (%)"; y.Min = -10; y.Max = 50; }) .AsAnimated() .Legend(l => l.TopRight()) .Series(s => s .AddBubble("Product A", new[] { new BubblePoint(12, 28, 85), // (X=market share, Y=growth, Z=revenue $M) new BubblePoint(22, 15, 120), new BubblePoint( 8, 42, 60), }) .AddBubble("Product B", new[] { new BubblePoint(30, 5, 200), new BubblePoint(18, 22, 95), new BubblePoint(35, -5, 140), })) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
